name: Heading
label: Heading
description: A heading whose outline level and type tier are chosen apart.

props.name: level
props.description: The heading's place in the document outline, which sets the element (`h1` to `h6`). Choose it for the outline, never for the size.

props.name: tier
props.description: The type style it wears, apart from `level`, so a card's `h3` can look like a small title and a page's `h1` like a display line. Defaults to the level's own: heading-1 to heading-3 for levels 1 to 3, title-body below.

props.name: tone
props.description: The colour role: `default` takes the tier's own (the display or heading text colour a theme can tone), `neutral` the secondary text colour for a quieter title.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Keep the heading on one line, ending in an ellipsis where it runs out of room. The full text stays in the accessible name.

props.name: balance
props.description: Balance the lines of a heading that wraps, so the last line is never a lone word.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the text sits on the line, along the reading direction.
